name: 15-seconds
description: 15 SECONDS — multiplayer HTML5 echo party game

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server
scripts.build:client: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client
